issues.description: Element: literal value of gemeindeschluessel used to select the target Gemeinde for Aufgabe 03. Problem statement (problem_statement.md) requests Zoos in the Gemeinde with Schluessel `09162000` (line 118). The reference solution (solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql) filters with WHERE gemeindeschluessel = '09162001' (line 3). The template (template_repository/aufgabe03.sql) is empty and does not resolve the discrepancy. This mismatch will confuse students which key to use and will cause automated equality checks or tests that expect one specific key to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Gemeindeschluessel consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update problem_statement.md to request Schluessel '09162001' to match the solution and tests, or (B) change solution_repository/aufgabe03.sql (and any tests) to use '09162000' to match the problem statement. Also ensure the template (template_repository/aufgabe03.sql) and any example data or comments reflect the chosen key so students are not confused.
